summary: Merged first-property plan for Casa Helena Palm Beach. Later calls supersede earlier ones where they conflict: leasing-agent assignment is now manual after Eli’s handoff; formal repayment agreements are enabled case by case; garages remain included in rent with no rentable-item setup at launch; automatic late fees begin at go-live; and renewal offers remain staff-controlled with only a 12-month term. The latest calls leave card acceptance unresolved, so payment types are a confirmation question rather than a final setting. The plan otherwise emphasizes Homebody, ACH-based payments, strict full-payment rules, automated delinquency, staff-run inspections, centralized maintenance, real-time availability, and role-based user access.
